$comment: F6 post-stream detector pass over the full H recording (services/clip/detector_pass.py, clipper.py detect). status 'proposed' = agent defaults, not tuned on full H recordings and not approved by the user. fps 1.0: the G1 full-screen live captures A5b/A5c were scanned at 1 fps (services/clip/coverage.py --fps default); nameMin 0.8 is the g1_scan default; diffGate 0.2 (g1_scan default 1.5, set on vertical cutouts): on a full 1280x720 generated frame a medal banner appearing on a static background changed the 1/4-scale mean luma by 0.70 and a small KILLCAM label by 0.27 (docs/evidence/2026-11-05-f6-detector-pass.md), so 1.5 skipped both; 0.2 still skips unchanged frames (diff 0.0); nameMin stays a proposal while data/games/codm/game.json nameMatch.minScore is null. mergeGapSec joins consecutive sampled frames of one detector and label into one hit (2.5 s = two missed 1 fps samples). roiSlack is the ROI tolerance in game-area fractions (as K1 in g1_scan). Detector weights are NOT here: they come from the game pack and count only when ranking.json detectorWeightsStatus is 'approved'. ocrRegions (2026-11-07, status in ocrRegionsStatus, docs/evidence/2026-11-07-roi-ocr-speed.md): 'full' OCRs the whole frame (the original pass); 'rois' OCRs only bands built from the pack ROIs (widened by the rule slack plus roiPad [x, y] game fractions, merged when the union adds no more than roiMergeArea), text detection per band and one batched recognition per frame, boxes mapped back to the full-frame coordinate space. roiEvery: detector id -> OCR its bands every Nth sampled frame (M1/M2 are post-match screens shown 2-50 s; their bands are the largest), boxes held in between. modeProbeEvery: once the mode (mp/br) is known only that mode's detector ROIs are read, all ROIs every Nth frame so a mode change is seen; 0 = always all. roiDetScale < 1 downscales bands for text detection only (measured: 0.75 already lost N1 and M5 hits, so 1.0). roiTextFilter true skips recognition of text centred outside the rule ROIs (measured: drops every N1 and most X1 hits on the H recording, whose KILLCAM and multi-kill texts sit outside the pack ROIs, so false). A band whose pixels did not change (diffGate on the band) keeps its last boxes.
